mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (as measured by the current value) compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand environment that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in lower earnings growth.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both below their 3-month moving averages) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 100k), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns as investors anticipate a peak in economic activity and subsequent policy tightening, which often precedes a market top.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1300 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to immediate economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1300, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economic slowdown materializes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a monetary policy response to overheating, which compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates and real interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL (both above their 3-month moving averages) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing production index (INDPRO) below 100 indicates a contraction in industrial output that reduces corporate profitability and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economic slowdown deepens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
